## Introduction

This ecosystem assessment tool from the EcoCAT project is designed for users who already have maps of ecosystems or habitats that they want perform an ecosystem assessment on following the [Red List of Ecosystem assessment guidelines](https://portals.iucn.org/library/sites/library/files/documents/2024-021-En.pdf "pdf file of the RLE ecosytem assessment guidelines"). This tool can generate the following:

-   Descriptive information of the mapped ecosystem

-   Criterion A (temporal change) - only when \>1 time period of data is uploaded

-   Criterion B (Area and extent of occurrence)

The ecosystem assessment tool will help provide standardised ecosystem assessments, to ensure ecosystem status are comparable across all assessed ecosystems.

## Methods

### Descriptive data

#### Rainfall

Historical rainfall data is currently extracted from [WorldClim verison 2.1](https://www.worldclim.org/data/worldclim21.html) at a 2.5 minute resolution

#### Temperature

Historical temperature data is currently extracted from [WorldClim verison 2.1](https://www.worldclim.org/data/worldclim21.html) at a 2.5 minute resolution.
